newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria raises par of 3-, 6-mth T-bill offers.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria raises par of 3-, 6-mth T-bill offers.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry raised the total par on offer for regular Monday's auctions of three- and six-month discount T-bills to 65 billion levs from 45 billion levs this week, central bank figures showed.

Raising the par was in line with Finance Ministry plans to offer fewer issues with larger par value in a bid to enable more institutions qualify at the auctions and boost secondary trade in government securities.
The ministry has also decided to halt daily 28-day discount issues from June 30 in favour of longer maturities to ease domestic debt servicing.
